$comment: REAL DATA, transcribed by hand from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFPM (AIP France, AMDT 07/26, chart dated 2026-06-11).
Only facts are recorded here; the charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed.
Runway geometry, taxiways, parking and frequencies also come from the simulator at run time; this file holds
what the simulator does not know: services, circuit rules and reporting points.
Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.
name: Melun-Villaroche

service.atsHours: TWR MON-FRI except public holidays 0800-1600 (UTC in winter, local time minus 1 h in summer)
service.outsideAtsHours: RMZ active during published AFIS hours (Melun Info, class G services); AFIS outside hours on PPR 48 h; otherwise air-air

preferredQfuReason: published preferred QFU; very noise-sensitive aerodrome

circuit.trainingPatterns: reserved for home-based aircraft; prohibited on weekends and public holidays
circuit.overheadTransit: minimum recommended transit altitude with traffic in the circuit: 1800 ft AMSL

notes: Flight intentions are mandatory on the tower frequency before taxiing. Backtrack is mandatory on runways 10/28 and 01/19; take-offs only from the thresholds.
Handling is mandatory for non-based aircraft over 3 t MTOW. Use between 2200 and 0600 local time needs the operator's authorisation (PPR 48 h).
Prohibited to gliders and balloons, ULM class 1, 2 and 5, and any ULM without radio and transponder.
While the RMZ is active the Melun CTR is not: services are those of class G, given by Melun Info.
Do not overfly the Evry-Gregy GRT GAZ station (150 m circle at 48 38 23 N 002 39 30 E) below 400 m.
